transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Since I watched that car get crushed in front of me last week, I’ve gone out of my way to avoid driving or even being near busy intersections. It was a horrific accident, and I'm just so shaken up that I can't bring myself to get behind the wheel anymore.
How long have these symptoms been bothering you, and have they persisted for more than a month?
They started immediately after the crash last week and have been happening constantly ever since. So it has only been about a week, not a month yet.
Have you noticed any ongoing distress or reactions like nightmares, flashbacks, or feeling on edge since the accident?

Yes, I've been having vivid flashbacks during the day where I suddenly see that car flipping and my chest clamps up. At night, I just lie there replaying the crash, and if I do fall asleep, I jerk awake at the slightest sound. Even at work, any sudden noise makes me jump out of my skin and sends my heart racing for minutes.
Have you experienced these symptoms every day since the accident, and have they lasted for most of the day?
Yes, they have been happening constantly every single day and night since the crash. I haven't had any real break from it, and it feels like it's hanging over me almost all day long.
Have your symptoms been ongoing every day since the accident, and do they continue to occur most of the day, every day?
Yes, absolutely. It has been happening every single day without fail since the crash last week. I haven't had a single day of relief, and it really does weigh on me all day long.
Have you experienced these symptoms every day since the accident, and do they continue to occur most of the day, every day?
Yes, that's correct. It has been happening every single day since the accident last week, and I haven't had any relief from it throughout the day.
Have you had these symptoms for less than four weeks, or do you expect them to last longer than a month?

Yes, it has only been about a week since the crash, so it has definitely been less than four weeks. I really hope it doesn't go on for longer than a month, but it has been completely constant since it started.
Have you experienced these symptoms every day since the accident, and do you expect them to last beyond one month from now?

Yes, I've had these symptoms every single day since the crash last week. I honestly don't know if they will last beyond a month, but I desperately hope they don't because this past week has been incredibly exhausting.
Have you ever experienced any similar symptoms or traumatic reactions like this before the recent accident?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before in my life. This is the very first time I've ever had these kinds of reactions, and it's completely new to me.
Have your symptoms been ongoing every day since the accident, and do they continue to occur most of the day, every day?

Yes, they have. It has been constant every single day since it happened last week, and I feel like I can't escape it from morning until night. There hasn't been a single day where I've felt back to normal.
